value.rationale: All third-order Fourier interpolation failures on the canonical dyadic cyclic groups receive an exact rank-level census for arbitrary k, with a structural 2-adic criterion and a quantitative 3/N asymptotic failure law. The rank-one onset at order 16 is a mathematically motivated boundary. This is a natural complete sampling invariant finer than full spark, not an arbitrary finite table or isolated computational increment.
